question: Two stored probe-body captures that evidence rows of crawler-scraper/searxng cite hold the address of the machine that ran the probe in the metadata block of an Anubis challenge page: sha256:669171f96f8762f6d6154e21327014cdba54f9045a161cccda1590469666a87e (baresearch.org, row dated 2026-10-31) and sha256:07789782d06ddc9b54a2938407f907a7c2d59b742b93012fe2222e1f65d6b8a3 (searx.oloke.xyz, row dated 2026-10-31). Should the two rows be dropped, the captures withheld from the stored sources, and the rows restated from a read of the page through the page reader, which shows the challenge text without the metadata block?
why: A saved challenge body cannot be redacted without changing its hash, so the address stays in the stored capture; a page-reader capture of baresearch.org (sha256:7e9bb971b39eb5e1bc2badcc13ce06f92bbb72924f99c8e33623c6ebe6a76bcb) carries the same challenge text with no address, and searx.oloke.xyz answered the reader with HTTP 503 on 2026-11-01.
